global_context.architecture_style: Clean Architecture with layered separation: domain -> repository -> service -> usecase -> handler -> cmd. Manual dependency injection in cmd/server/dependencies.go.
global_context.api_pattern: REST with versioned API (v1/v2/v3). Fiber v3 framework. Standardized JSON responses with status/data/error wrapper.
global_context.auth_pattern: JWT (HS256/RS256) with dual-secret support (access/refresh tokens). Personal API Keys (cosmo_pk_* prefix). Google OAuth2 for agent email accounts. Microsoft Azure AD for Outlook.
global_context.database: PostgreSQL via GORM ORM. Redis for caching, task queues (Asynq), and vector store (RediSearch). SQLite for testing.
global_context.testing_approach: Go test with testify assertions. Integration tests via build tags. Test token generation utility in cmd/generate_test_token/.
common_patterns: Soft delete via is_deleted boolean flag on all domain models
Multi-tenant isolation via UserID on all entities
JSONB fields for flexible metadata (CMetadata pattern)
Generic repository pattern with BaseRepository[T] interface and GormRepository[T] implementation
Paginated results via PaginationParams and PaginatedResult[T]
Background job processing via Asynq with Redis backend
Temporal workflows for complex long-running operations
Structured logging with zerolog and request ID tracking
